descriptionHtml:
darkFlash DY470 White ATX Gaming Case - Back-Connect Compatible With 7 ARGB Fans (Pre-installed 7 ARGB Cooling Fans / Panoramic Glass Panel / Supports Back-Connect Motherboards / Dual 360mm Radiator Support / 410mm GPU Clearance / USB Type-C Front I/O / 1 Year Official Local Agent Warranty)

Showcase your ultimate PC build with the darkFlash DY470 White ATX Gaming Case equipped with 7 pre-installed ARGB Fans, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Local Agent Warranty. Specifically designed with full Back-Connect motherboard compatibility, this premium chassis enables an ultra-clean interior layout by hiding power cables behind the tray. Featuring vibrant ARGB illumination, panoramic tempered glass panels, extensive cooling capability supporting dual 360mm radiators, high GPU clearance up to 410mm, and a modern USB Type-C front port, the DY470 delivers exceptional airflow and aesthetic elegance.
